_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for MOCK data. Served by backend/main.py and imported by frontend/src/data/mock.js. Replace per-KPI when LIVE sources come online (Phase 2/3). Company values describe a FICTIONAL asset-light functional food CPG (~$75M revenue) — a demo operating profile, not a real company. Competitor names are real; competitor values are directional demo estimates (confidence: guessing) unless the source field cites a real public source.

company.name: Food Lube
company.profile: Fictional demo profile: functional food/beverage CPG, ≈$75M net revenue, asset-light (co-manufacturer production, 3PL logistics, broker-supported sales).

kpis.name: Velocity (units/store/week)
kpis.note: the most important CPG number; ~1+ healthy in natural

competitors.name: Campbell's (Swanson · Pacific)
competitors.note: Owns Swanson — the #1-selling US broth (Circana via Food Dive, 2022) — and Pacific Foods.

competitors.name: Knorr (Unilever)
competitors.note: Global leader in bouillon, stocks & concentrates; division of Unilever — divisional financials not separately reported.

competitors.name: Better Than Bouillon (Summit Hill)
competitors.note: Category-defining paste concentrates. Private company — financials unobservable.

competitors.name: Pacific Foods (Campbell's)
competitors.note: Premium organic carton broths, ≈$130M (Campbell's investor materials).

competitors.name: Kettle & Fire
competitors.note: VC-backed bone-broth leader; $43M secondary (Feb 2025, PitchBook/CB Insights). Private — most financials unobservable.

competitors.name: Imagine (Hain Celestial)
competitors.note: Organic broths & soups. Parent Hain Celestial net sales declined from $1.78B (FY23) to ≈$1.53B TTM (Apr 2026).

courier._note: Courier-style company overview. Terminology adapted from the Capstone Courier report; every value is illustrative demo data (fictional profile) unless a source is cited. $ figures in $K unless noted.

sections.h: Changes In Current Assets And Liabilities

incomeStatement: Variable Costs (Materials, Co-Man, Freight, Inventory Carry)

marketShare.note: $ share of segment, L52W — illustrative directional estimates (syndicated Circana/NIQ data not public). Segment sizes are illustrative estimates of the addressable broth & concentrates sub-category (≈$813M), not the full $5.9B soup market.
